title: Mutex lock uses .unwrap() in every handler
suggestion: A panic while holding the lock poisons the Mutex, turning every subsequent request into a 500; map the poison error to an HttpError instead.

title: Synchronous rusqlite calls run inside async handlers
evidence: src/main.rs:74-122 — blocking rusqlite calls in #[tokio] handlers with a single shared connection
suggestion: Acceptable for this task; under load consider a connection pool or spawn_blocking to avoid stalling the async runtime.

title: PUT /books/{id} requires all fields (full replace, not partial update)
evidence: src/main.rs:107 update_book deserializes BookInput, whose title/author are mandatory
suggestion: Spec says 'update'; full-replace PUT semantics are reasonable, but a PATCH-style partial update is not supported. No deduction.
